source.evidence: Both checked-in v12 JSONDropKeys binaries embed this VCS revision, vcs.modified=false, and module json_drop_keys_udf. This is source provenance, not a reproducible original binary comparison.

compatibility.warning: Do not overwrite v12 with util/cmd/json_drop_keys_udf: its current implementation preserves dotted JSON keys and propagates drop filters through arrays, unlike v12.
compatibility.architectureRequirement: Run the regression on a matching Linux architecture, or under explicit emulation. The arm64 command substitutes aarch64 for x86_64.

canvasEsbuild.sourceRebuildCommand: GOTOOLCHAIN=local CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -mod=readonly -buildvcs=false -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w -buildid=' -o /external-output/esbuild ./cmd/esbuild
canvasEsbuild.sourceRebuildRequirement: Run from the checksum-verified archive with Go 1.27.3; select GOARCH for the image target. Replace the corresponding @esbuild/linux-{x64,arm64}/bin/esbuild after npm ci, keep the matching 0.28.2 JS wrapper, and verify the binary protocol/version through the actual Canvas builder.
canvasEsbuild.effectiveBuilderNodeEngine: >=20 (already required by @posthog/quill and @tailwindcss/oxide; the esbuild upgrade does not raise it)
canvasEsbuild.runtimeVersionEvidence: Downloaded official linux-x64 and linux-arm64 npm tarballs. Each binary contains one distinct Go runtime version string, go1.26.5. Their stripped ELF files have no Go build-info header; do not claim go version -m provenance for them.
canvasEsbuild.qualification: The bundled go1.26.5 is past the CVE-2025-68121 fixed version, but older than current go1.26.10/go1.27.3. Full current-vulnerability scanning remains required; an npm version upgrade alone does not prove the binary has no other vulnerabilities.
